answer_1.quote: We propose a novel framework composed of three major components, namely a personas generator, a dialogue response generator and a critic network... Our framework generates partner personas ... and generate more diverse and engaging responses.

answer_2.quote: For both PPG and DRG, perplexity (PPL) is reported to measure the intrinsic performance ... We adopt well-known sequence evaluation metrics weighted BLEU and Fmeasure for ROUGE-L ... For PPG, we also report Distinct-N with N={1,2} to measure the response diversity.

answer_4.quote: We hired experienced annotators who have degrees relevant to English Linguistics to conduct evaluation on PERSONACHAT-ORI. For both DRG and PPG, we present a questionnaire composed of 800 questions with randomly sampled 200 test instances to three annotators who compare model outputs under A/B testing.
answer_4.guideline: A questionnaire of 800 questions (200 test instances) presented to three human annotators for pairwise A/B comparison of model outputs.
